name: Contra Costa Crisis Center
description: The Contra Costa Crisis Center provides 24/7 crisis intervention, suicide prevention, and grief counseling services to Contra Costa County residents.
fullDescription: The Contra Costa Crisis Center provides 24/7 crisis intervention, suicide prevention, and grief counseling services to Contra Costa County residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 crisis and suicide hotline
- Crisis text line (text HOPE to 20121)
- 24-hour grief phone counseling and bereavement support groups in Walnut Creek
- 211 information and referral to local resources
- Free and confidential support
howToGetIt: Call 988 or 800-273-8255 anytime for crisis support, or text HOPE to 20121. For grief counseling, call 211 or 800-830-5380.
keywords: Contra Costa Crisis Center, suicide hotline, grief counseling, crisis intervention, text HOPE, mental health crisis
